1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Create a narrative report for each incident record.
   a. Put summaries of any investigation findings and corrective actions taken in the second column.
   b. Fill in the date column for the last day you worked on the incident, which typically coincides with when the worker returned to normal work.
   c. During the OSH Process database export process, enter each incident report in the incidence database.
3. Create an e-mail summary for e-mailing to the CHPO.
4. Create an entry in the CHPAS database.
5. Create an "Incident Weekly Summary" for e-mailing to Fogarty and CTA. # Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents
